papers.title: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. Yet problem solving in unfamiliar domains calls for tightly coupled knowledge acquisition and reasoning, beyond factual retrieval and aggregation or learning solely from a preassembled context. We study self-learning -- autonomously retrieving, studying, and applying knowledge from long-form reference materials on the fly. To investigate this capability, we formulate a textbook-based mathematical problem-solving task. LLMs must navigate textbook exposition, learn and apply relevant principles, and construct proofs for exercises, with reference solutions withheld. We introduce a BookNavigator interface to support this human-inspired study process and incentivize self-learning through reinforcement learning (RL) with fine-grained rewards. Experiments show that our method improves performance across in-domain and out-of-domain textbooks and subjects, raising Intern-S2-Preview-35B's overall proof accuracy from 51.5% to 79.5% and outperforming RL-trained textbook-free and fixed-retrieval baselines. These gains extend to complex long-context benchmarks involving different task types, with improvements over the base model of 1.7 and 2.3 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus and CL-bench, respectively. Together, these findings suggest that RL can foster a domain-agnostic self-learning strategy, highlighting the potential of self-learning from long-form corpora to strengthen broader problem-solving capabilities on complex, long-context tasks.

summary.takeaway: 提出基于教科书的数学解题任务与BookNavigator接口，用细粒度奖励的强化学习激励LLM自主检索、学习和应用长文本参考材料中的知识。
summary.methods: 构建教科书数学问题求解任务，要求模型导航教材内容、学习原理并构造证明（隐藏参考解）；设计BookNavigator接口，采用带细粒度奖励的RL训练；与无教材、固定检索的RL基线对比，并在BrowseComp-Plus与CL-bench上评估。
summary.relevance: 直接对应大语言模型、检索增强与对齐以及强化学习主题，探索RL驱动的自学习策略而非静态RAG。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告Intern-S2-Preview-35B等实验的提升数值，未给出训练数据规模、奖励设计细节与跨任务泛化的完整消融。

papers.title: MLLM-GS: Multimodal Large Language Model Prior-Guided Fast Novel View Synthesis in Extreme Environments
papers.abstract: Novel view synthesis (NVS) in degraded scenes aims to reconstruct 3D scenes from multi-view observations affected by various degradations, and to generate clear and photorealistic images at unseen viewpoints. Despite recent advances, existing methods often rely on degradation-specific models, limiting their generalization across diverse extreme environments. Generative models provide rich visual priors, but their outputs often suffer from pixel misalignment and color deviations, which can propagate into the reconstructed 3D scene and compromise reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the high computational and memory costs of 3D reconstruction hinder the practical application of NVS in extreme environments. To this end, we propose MLLM-GS, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) prior-guided framework for fast NVS in extreme environments. MLLM-GS consists of two branches: MLLM prior-guided view enhancement and fast 3D scene reconstruction. The former leverages the rich visual priors of a frozen MLLM to enhance views under different severe degradations and introduces a lightweight correction network to reduce pixel shifts and color distortions in MLLM outputs. With supervision from only a few paired clean views, this branch produces reliable enhanced views for all degraded observations, providing pseudo-GT views for subsequent 3D reconstruction. The latter improves 3DGS efficiency by optimizing rasterization, Gaussian memory layout, and parameter updates, reducing redundant computation, memory-access overhead, and optimization costs. Extensive experiments on multiple degraded scenes demonstrate that MLLM-GS effectively handles various severe degradations and achieves high-quality NVS with significantly lower reconstruction time and memory consumption. Project Page: https://wzlwlm13.github.io/MLLM-GS

summary.takeaway: 提出MLLM-GS框架，利用冻结多模态大模型的视觉先验增强退化视图，并结合加速的3DGS实现极端环境下的快速新视角合成。
summary.methods: 双分支设计：MLLM先验引导的视图增强（含轻量校正网络减少像素偏移与颜色失真，仅需少量配对干净视图监督）与快速3D场景重建（优化光栅化、高斯内存布局与参数更新）；在多种退化场景上实验。
summary.relevance: 涉及多模态大模型与多模态学习，但并非检索增强或对齐主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体量化指标与基线对比数值，泛化性仅在所述退化场景上验证。

papers.title: Textual Response-Aware Guidance for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Existing adversarial fine-tuning methods often use pre-trained model guidance to preserve image--text alignment while improving robustness. Our analysis of visual representation drift reveals complementary limitations of two representative forms of guidance. Matching visual features provides broad coverage by constraining all directions equally, but lacks semantic emphasis. Matching prediction distributions prioritizes semantically relevant directions, but remains limited by the candidate texts and prediction probabilities. These limitations can hinder preservation of pre-trained image--text relationships and degrade zero-shot performance. To address these issues, we propose Textual Response-Aware Guidance (TRAG), which constrains visual representation drift using the pre-trained text encoder's responses to local variations in input embeddings. Specifically, TRAG constructs anchor-level constraints from the response directions and magnitudes around semantic anchors, then aggregates them using pre-trained image--anchor relevance, yielding an image-adaptive constraint. Extensive experiments across architectures and tasks demonstrate state-of-the-art clean and robust performance. Further analysis shows that TRAG helps preserve pre-trained image--text relationships.

summary.takeaway: 提出文本响应感知引导TRAG，利用预训练文本编码器对输入嵌入局部变化的响应约束视觉表示漂移，提升VLM零样本对抗鲁棒性。
summary.methods: 分析视觉特征匹配与预测分布匹配两类引导的互补局限；基于语义锚点周围的响应方向与幅度构造锚级约束，并用预训练图文相关性聚合为图像自适应约束；跨架构与任务实验。
summary.relevance: 契合检索增强与对齐及多模态学习主题，关注保持预训练图文对齐的鲁棒微调。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体鲁棒性与零样本精度的数值，也未说明计算开销。

papers.title: M-PFT: Angular Margin for Calibrated Prompt-Tuning of Fine-Tuned Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Prompt-tuning has emerged as a parameter-efficient technique for adapting large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks while keeping the pre-trained weights frozen. However, prompt-tuned VLMs often suffer from a base-to-novel dual miscalibration problem, where models typically show underconfidence on base classes and overconfidence on novel classes. Current VLM calibration approaches address this dual miscalibration either separately or jointly, but lack a geometric understanding of the hyperspherical embedding space and thus fail to exploit angular discriminative properties to adjust distorted decision boundaries. To address this, we propose M-PFT, a novel angular-margin approach for prompt tuning that introduces two complementary objectives to promote class discriminability and semantic anchoring. This enlarges the angular margin by 1) minimizing the maximum cosine similarity between tunable class embeddings to reduce embedding collapse and 2) minimizing the angular distance between each tunable embedding and its corresponding zero-shot embedding to preserve semantic geometry. Extensive experiments across 9 prompt-tuning methods with various backbones on 15 diverse datasets show that our approach reduces the average calibration error on novel classes, while remaining competitive on base classes and maintaining comparable accuracy. Further analyses reveal that M-PFT effectively adjusts distorted decision boundaries induced by prompt tuning while preserving the pre-trained embedding space, improving calibration with negligible computational overhead.
authors: Udaya Sampath K. Perera Miriya Thanthrige

summary.takeaway: 提出M-PFT角度间隔提示微调方法，缓解提示微调VLM在基类欠自信、新类过自信的双重校准问题。
summary.methods: 在提示微调中引入两个目标：最小化可调类嵌入间最大余弦相似度以增强类判别性，最小化可调嵌入与其零样本嵌入的角度距离以保持语义几何；在9种提示微调方法、多种骨干与15个数据集上评估。
summary.relevance: 对应多模态学习与跨模态理解中的VLM适配与校准，属对齐相关但非检索增强。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体校准误差数值，改进主要集中在新类校准，基类仅保持竞争力。

papers.title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
papers.abstract: Foundation models are typically trained in stages: pretraining, midtraining, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL), with changes in both data and learning algorithms. We show that this algorithmic separation is not fundamental. By deriving suitable RL objectives as maximum-likelihood fitting to model-generated target distributions, we place all of these stages under a single likelihood-based training algorithm, unified training. This perspective turns the foundation-model training lifecycle into a problem of choosing which data to train on, in what proportions, and when, with conventional staged training as a special case. We instantiate this framework in a unified training system that mixes static data and RL generations within a single trainer. Across controlled and real-world experiments, unified training improves the accuracy-compute tradeoff and task coverage while preserving broader capabilities, and provides a stronger starting point for continual learning. This work lays the groundwork for a unified science of foundation-model training, connecting mathematical principles, training infrastructure, and the development of model capabilities.

summary.takeaway: 将预训练、中训练、SFT与RL统一为对模型生成目标分布的最大似然拟合，提出单一似然训练算法unified training。
summary.methods: 推导各阶段对应的RL目标作为最大似然拟合，在单一训练器中混合静态数据与RL生成；开展受控与真实实验，评估精度-计算权衡、任务覆盖与持续学习起点。
summary.relevance: 直接关联强化学习、持续学习与预训练主题，为对齐训练提供统一框架。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体实验数值与规模，统一框架的实际收益幅度需查看全文。

papers.title: Aligning Medical Vision Language Models at the Capability Boundary with Entropy Adaptive Rubric Grounding
papers.abstract: Medical diagnostic reasoning requires verifiable links between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, yet current medical vision language models are aligned with objectives that reward the wrong behavior. Uniform supervised fine tuning lets easy cases dominate updates while clinically critical boundary cases saturate prematurely. Sparse rewards based only on final-answer correctness cannot assess anatomical grounding or clinical logic, inviting reward hacking through answer shortcuts. We propose MedCBR, a two-stage alignment framework coupling boundary-aware preference optimization with rubric-grounded reinforcement learning. First, we construct counterfactual boundary preferences at the model's capability frontier using empirical pass rates and preference pairs that share reasoning prefixes but diverge at decisive diagnostic branches. Difficulty Weighted Boundary Preference Optimization (DBPO) concentrates learning on this calibrated boundary region. Second, we distill reusable clinical rubrics from boundary trajectories and activate them according to prediction entropy. Entropy Gated Grounded Policy Optimization (EGPO) rewards answer correctness, anatomical grounding, and reasoning fidelity while suppressing rubric noise on reliable samples. A reference policy anchored to the boundary-aligned model couples population-level boundary priors with instance-level uncertainty, making diagnostic reasoning more accurate and clinically grounded. Experiments on six medical benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong general, specialized, and reinforcement learning baselines, reaching 61.2% average accuracy with the largest gains on challenging differential diagnosis tasks. Ablations show super-additive gains: combining the two stages exceeds the sum of their individual improvements.

summary.takeaway: 提出MedCBR两阶段对齐框架，在模型能力边界上用熵自适应评分标准接地，提升医学视觉语言模型的诊断推理与解剖 grounding。
summary.methods: 先用经验通过率构造反事实边界偏好对，实施难度加权边界偏好优化DBPO；再从边界轨迹蒸馏临床评分标准，按预测熵门控激活，实施熵门控接地策略优化EGPO，奖励答案正确性、解剖定位与推理保真；在六个医学基准上实验。
summary.relevance: 融合强化学习、多模态学习与对齐主题，针对医学VLM的奖励设计与偏好优化。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出61.2%平均准确率，未详述评分标准构建成本与跨机构数据泛化。

papers.title: Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live IOS Apps
papers.abstract: While frontier vision-language models demonstrate strong capabilities in user interface (UI) navigation, their high inference costs prohibit everyday use. Conversely, smaller models trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or offline reinforcement learning often memorize static trajectories, leading to brittle execution and an inability to recover from errors. To address these limitations, we propose a novel online reinforcement learning framework that trains UI navigation agents directly on live iOS applications. Our framework decouples the agent into two specialized components: a Planning agent and a UI Grounding model. We rely on an LLM-as-a-Judge to provide comprehensive reward signals, combining dense, step-level feedback to evaluate intermediate progress with a terminal reward for overall task completion. To effectively leverage this dual reward structure, we optimize the agent using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with step-level advantage estimation. Furthermore, we introduce GiGPPO, a novel neighbor-conditioned value estimation method that improves critic stability by leveraging reward signals from visually similar states across concurrent trajectories. To support this online training paradigm at scale, we introduce an efficient infrastructure that orchestrates hundreds of concurrent virtual iOS devices. Evaluations on rigorous benchmarks, including UINavBench, iOSWorld, and AndroidWorld, demonstrate that our online RL trained agents substantially outperform both SFT and terminal-only RL baselines while accelerating training convergence. Notably, our 8B RL agents achieve nearly a sevenfold improvement over the SFT baseline in out-of-distribution generalization to Android environments, while outperforming Gemini-3.5-Flash and tying with Gemini-3.1-Pro on real iOS applications.

summary.takeaway: 提出在真实iOS应用上在线训练UI导航智能体的框架，将智能体解耦为规划智能体与UI grounding模型，并用PPO与步骤级优势估计优化。
summary.methods: LLM-as-a-Judge提供密集步骤奖励与终端完成奖励；采用PPO及步骤级优势估计，提出邻居条件价值估计GiGPPO以稳定critic；构建支持数百并发虚拟iOS设备的基础设施；在UINavBench、iOSWorld、AndroidWorld上评估。
summary.relevance: 对应强化学习与多模态学习主题，涉及视觉语言模型智能体的在线RL训练。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体基准分数，除8B模型约七倍OOD提升外缺少详细对比数值；依赖LLM评审奖励可能引入偏差。

papers.title: Evaluating Cultural Knowledge Editing in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Current Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently fail to recognize culture-specific concepts, especially from underrepresented regions. Effectively injecting this long-tail knowledge into existing models remains a challenge. In this work, we investigate knowledge editing as a targeted alternative by introducing CulturalBind, a benchmark comprising 3.2K images of 1K concepts from 6 domains, designed to evaluate culture-aware cross-modal knowledge as well as concept-level knowledge editing in VLMs. Pre-edit evaluation reveals that textual and visual knowledge is decoupled: models often demonstrate text-based knowledge of cultural concepts but fail to identify them from images. We then evaluate editing methods in single and sequential scenarios. Although current methods successfully correct individual visual recognition errors, they exhibit low cross-modal portability, failing to integrate edits into the model's broader parametric knowledge. Furthermore, performance degrades rapidly under sequential editing, highlighting the need for comprehensive adaptation approaches that better consolidate multimodal knowledge over time.

summary.takeaway: 构建CulturalBind基准评估VLM文化知识编辑，发现文本与视觉文化知识解耦，现有编辑方法跨模态可迁移性低且顺序编辑下性能快速下降。
summary.methods: 基准含6个领域、1K概念的3.2K图像；先做编辑前评估，再在单次与顺序场景下评估知识编辑方法。
summary.relevance: 对应多模态学习与跨模态理解主题，评估VLM知识注入与对齐。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体编辑方法名称与量化结果，结论基于该基准的覆盖范围。

papers.title: Telling Is Not Seeing: Textual Personas Rarely Make Vision-Language Models Answer Like the People They Describe
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly prompted with personas, such as "You have low vision", to stand in for people in user studies. We ask whether a persona makes a model see like the person it describes. We compare persona answers with measured people with low vision, color blindness or hearing loss, and with simple rules that use only the facts the persona states. The persona never beats these rules, and it erases the real differences between groups and individuals. Describing blur leaves recognition unchanged in all 14 models we test, while blurring the photo lowers it as it does for people. Inside open models, the description changes neither the image information nor the answer probabilities. Yet the models know the effects they fail to show: they can estimate how blur and illusions affect people. Telling is not seeing: a persona makes a model say what it knows about people, not see what they see.

summary.takeaway: 研究发现，给视觉语言模型（VLM）设定人格描述（如“你有低视力”）并不会让模型像所描述的人那样感知或作答，模型无法超越仅使用人格事实的简单规则。
summary.methods: 将人格提示下模型的回答与真实低视力、色盲或听力受损人群的测量结果比较，并与仅利用人格所陈述事实的简单规则对比；在14个模型上测试描述模糊对识别的影响，并分析开源模型内部的图像信息与答案概率。
summary.relevance: 针对多模态学习和跨模态理解，考察视觉语言模型的人格提示能否模拟人类感知，涉及模型对人类视觉差异的建模能力。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体数据集规模、统计显著性或模型选择细节；结论主要基于所测14个模型和特定感知任务，泛化性需全文确认。

papers.title: Escaping Path Mirages in Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning remains challenging in stochastic long-horizon settings, where compounding value estimation errors hinder reliable goal reaching. While prior methods have sought to address this challenge through various approaches, a key challenge remains path mirage, where agents overcommit to spuriously successful trajectories in offline datasets induced by stochasticity, often leading to failure on difficult tasks. To address this issue, we propose Branch-aware Graph Planning (BGP), which captures stochastic branching structures by identifying high-variability points as graph nodes and designing goal-conditioned edges with segmented learning to avoid unreliable branches and reduce unnecessary stochasticity along paths. As a result, BGP enables reliable goal reaching even in highly stochastic long-horizon environments, and experiments on diverse OGBench tasks show that it substantially outperforms prior state-of-the-art offline goal-conditioned RL methods. Our implementation is available at https://umlic.github.io/papers/BGP/.

summary.takeaway: 提出Branch-aware Graph Planning（BGP），通过识别高变性点作为图节点并分段学习目标条件边，缓解离线目标条件强化学习中的“路径海市蜃楼”问题。
summary.methods: 在离线目标条件强化学习中构建分支感知图规划，以高可变性点作为节点，设计目标条件边并分段学习；在OGBench多种任务上评估。
summary.relevance: 与强化学习主题直接相关，针对离线目标条件RL在随机长程环境中的价值估计和虚假成功轨迹问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体性能数值、消融结果和环境规模；对非随机或短程任务的适用性未说明。

papers.title: Safe Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning: Zero Constraint Violation and Primal-Averaging Convergence
papers.abstract: Many applications of multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) require policies that balance conflicting objectives while satisfying safety constraints. We study safe MORL with zero constraint violation throughout learning, covering both cumulative and stepwise constraints. A key challenge is to explore sufficiently under unknown dynamics and constraint costs without violating the constraints. For a given preference over objectives, we develop an algorithm to learn a safe Pareto optimal policy by combining optimistic reward estimates with pessimistic cost bounds. With high probability, every policy executed over $T$ episodes incurs zero constraint violation. The algorithm returns a safe Markov policy induced by the averaged occupancy measure and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ suboptimality gap under smooth Tchebycheff scalarization. We further develop a preference-free algorithm that first explores safely without a prespecified preference and then computes a safe policy for any given preference without further interaction. Over $T$ exploration episodes and $K$ planning iterations, it retains the same safety guarantee and achieves an $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{T}+1/\sqrt{K})$ suboptimality gap. Both algorithms require knowledge of a policy that strictly satisfies the constraints and its costs. We then relax these requirements, incurring at most constant cumulative violation. To our knowledge, we provide the first sample-efficient MORL algorithms that guarantee safety for every executed policy.

summary.takeaway: 提出安全多目标强化学习算法，在累积和逐步约束下保证学习过程中零约束违反，并给出原始平均策略的收敛性保证。
summary.methods: 结合乐观奖励估计与悲观成本界，在给定偏好下学习安全Pareto最优策略；返回由平均占用测度诱导的安全Markov策略，在平滑Tchebycheff标量化下达到Õ(1/√T)次优间隙；进一步提出无偏好算法，先安全探索再对任意偏好规划。
summary.relevance: 与强化学习及安全对齐相关，研究多目标权衡与约束满足下的样本高效学习。
summary.caveat: 算法需要已知严格满足约束的策略及其成本；放宽该要求后仅能保证常数级累积违反；结果基于理论分析，摘要未提供实证细节。

papers.title: MRC-MMAgent: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Role Collaboration in Multimodal Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract: Multimodal tool-using agents augment vision-language models with access to external information and capabilities, enabling them to solve knowledge-intensive and visually complex tasks that cannot be addressed using visual context alone. However, existing reinforcement learning pipelines largely train single-role agents to search and answer using terminal rewards, overlooking how humans inspect retrieved evidence, reformulate queries, and revise conclusions during search. Consequently, they fail to optimize this self-corrective process over complete interaction trajectories. We propose MRC-MMAgent, a multi-role collaborative reinforcement learning framework that incorporates trajectory assessment and continuation directly into the executable agent loop. First, the framework establishes a multi-role collaborative loop that integrates solving, inspection, and continuation, enabling the agent to acquire evidence through tools, evaluate the preceding trajectory, and resume problem solving when the current answer is insufficiently supported. Second, we introduce a role-coupled learning objective that combines task success, interaction validity, and successful correction with full-trajectory policy optimization across the decisions generated by all roles. Extensive experiments show that, using only the original baseline training set without constructing additional datasets, our method consistently outperforms the corresponding base models and achieves leading or highly competitive performance across benchmarks.

summary.takeaway: 提出MRC-MMAgent，将多角色协作（求解、检查、继续）和轨迹评估融入可执行智能体循环，用强化学习优化多模态工具使用中的自我纠错过程。
summary.methods: 构建多角色协作强化学习框架，角色包括求解、检查和继续；设计角色耦合学习目标，结合任务成功、交互有效性和成功纠正，进行全轨迹策略优化；仅使用原始基线训练集。
summary.relevance: 直接关联强化学习、多模态学习和跨模态理解与生成，关注多模态工具使用智能体的训练与对齐。
summary.caveat: 摘要未列出具体基准名称和数值，也未说明训练成本或多角色间的冲突；领先或竞争性表现的统计细节需全文确认。

papers.title: Don't Lose the Thread: Empowering Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation
papers.abstract: Agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in solving complex reasoning tasks. However, LLM agents often falter on long-horizon tasks due to cognitive overload, as their working memory becomes cluttered with expanding and irrelevant information, which dilutes their attention and hinders effective planning and reasoning. To mitigate this challenge, we introduce Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation (CORAL), a novel reasoning paradigm that empowers agents to proactively optimize their context. Implemented as an agent-callable working memory management toolset, CORAL allows an agent to checkpoint its task progress and verified facts, and adaptively initiate a new problem-solving episode by resetting cluttered context while preserving only the checkpointed information, enabling it to resume reasoning from a clean state. We further enhance the agent's checkpointing capabilities using a Multi-episode Agentic Reinforced Policy Optimization algorithm. On the GAIA benchmark, CORAL with an 8B model achieves 42.8% average accuracy, with particularly strong gains on the most challenging long-horizon tasks (Level 2 and Level 3). Crucially, these gains come at a substantially lower inference cost: CORAL consumes 6-7$\times$ fewer input tokens than a ReAct agent. It also generalizes to multi-hop Knowledge QA benchmarks and to the considerably harder BrowseComp, where it improves a strong proprietary agent by 8.0 points.

summary.takeaway: 提出CORAL，一种让LLM智能体主动管理工作记忆的推理范式，通过检查点保存进度和事实并重置杂乱上下文，缓解长程任务中的认知过载。
summary.methods: 将工作记忆管理实现为智能体可调用的工具集，支持保存检查点并开启新问题求解片段；使用Multi-episode Agentic Reinforced Policy Optimization增强检查点能力；在GAIA、多跳知识QA和BrowseComp上评估。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型、检索增强与对齐及强化学习相关，关注长程智能体的上下文管理和强化学习训练。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告8B模型在GAIA上42.8%平均准确率和输入token减少6-7倍等结果，但未说明基线细节、方差或任务划分；对非长程任务的收益未明确。

papers.title: H$^2$R: Hierarchical Hint-Based Reward for Mathematical Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards has shown great promise in enhancing mathematical reasoning in large language models. However, existing approaches provide limited intermediate supervision for complex, multi-step reasoning tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{Hierarchical Hint-based Reward}, a framework that leverages the intrinsic sub-question structure of mathematical problems as structured intermediate conditioning signals during RLVR training. Unlike chain-of-thought prompting, these hierarchical hints serve as logically grounded intermediate milestones that effectively reduce the reasoning horizon toward the final answer. To validate this framework, we introduce \textbf{HiMath}, a benchmark of hierarchically structured mathematical problems. Across diverse LLMs, hierarchical hints consistently improve reasoning performance even without task-specific training. When integrated into RL training via H$^2$R, they boost Qwen2.5-Math-7B accuracy on HiMath from 30.4\% to 39.1\% using hierarchical hints, and up to 45.6\% with Oracle Hierarchical Hints. This pronounced improvement demonstrates that incorporating reliable intermediate checkpoints into reward design is essential for sustaining complex mathematical reasoning.

summary.takeaway: 提出Hierarchical Hint-based Reward（H$^2$R），利用数学问题的子问题层级结构作为中间奖励信号，并引入HiMath基准验证其有效性。
summary.methods: 在带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练中，将层级提示作为逻辑上可靠的中间里程碑融入奖励设计；构建分层结构的数学问题基准HiMath，并在多种LLM上测试。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型、检索增强与对齐及强化学习相关，关注数学推理的中间监督和奖励设计。
summary.caveat: 摘要给出的提升数值（Qwen2.5-Math-7B在HiMath上从30.4%到39.1%，Oracle提示达45.6%）依赖特定基准和提示设置；层级提示的构建成本及对其他推理任务的泛化性未说明。

papers.title: LoRe-MIM: Lost-or-Replaced Masked Image Modeling for Self-Supervised Representation Learning in Whole-Body PET/CT
papers.abstract: Deep learning models for whole-body positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) hold significant clinical potential for disease detection, treatment planning, and response assessment. However, the time and cost associated with expert annotations remain major bottlenecks in developing robust and generalizable models. Although self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising approach to mitigating annotation scarcity, its application to whole-body PET/CT remains relatively underexplored due to the limited availability of large-scale datasets and the challenges associated with learning complementary cross-modal representations. To address these limitations, we curate a heterogeneous, multi-tracer, multi-institutional cohort comprising 6,531 whole-body PET/CT scans and propose LoRe-MIM (Lost-Or-Replaced Masked Image Modelling), a novel self-supervised framework designed to learn multimodal representations through masked image reconstruction. Specifically, LoRe-MIM introduces a masking strategy in which image regions are either replaced with zeros (Lost) or substituted with corresponding complementary imaging modality (Replaced), encouraging the model to capture both modality-specific characteristics and cross-modal relationships. We evaluate the learned representations across multiple downstream tasks, including multimodal PET/CT image reconstruction, patch-based classification into cancer vs. non-cancer, whole-body lesion segmentation, label-efficient training, and robustness assessment. Experimental results demonstrate that LoRe-MIM consistently outperforms the corresponding state-of-the-art baselines across these tasks, highlighting its potential as a scalable and generalizable self-supervised learning framework for whole-body PET/CT analysis.

summary.takeaway: 提出LoRe-MIM，通过“丢失或替换”掩码图像建模学习全身PET/CT的多模态自监督表示，在多个下游任务上优于对应基线。
summary.methods: 构建包含6,531例全身PET/CT扫描的多示踪剂、多机构异质队列；掩码策略将图像区域置零（Lost）或替换为互补模态图像（Replaced），促使模型同时学习模态特有特征和跨模态关系；在下游任务上评估。
summary.relevance: 与自监督与表示学习、跨模态理解与生成及检索增强与对齐相关，面向医学多模态数据的无标注表示学习。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体性能数值、队列标注质量和下游任务细节；多机构异质队列的偏见与外部验证情况需全文确认。

papers.title: IMRouter: Imbalance-aware Temporal Pattern Routing for LLM-based Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract: Accurate time series forecasting (TSF) is essential for Web applications, such as traffic monitoring and online resource management. Recent advances in leveraging pre-trained large language models (LLMs) have shown promising performance in TSF. However, existing LLM-based TSF methods largely optimize the overall forecasting objective while overlooking temporal pattern imbalance (TPI), where different temporal patterns occur at highly unequal frequencies. Our empirical analysis reveals that TPI is prevalent across widely used TSF benchmarks, with substantially higher forecasting errors on less frequent patterns. To address this issue, we propose IMRouter (Imbalance-aware Temporal Pattern Routing), a novel framework that mitigates TPI-induced biases in both temporal representation learning and cross-modal alignment. Specifically, IMRouter introduces Pattern-Adaptive Temporal Representation Learning (PATR), which leverages gradient conflict and local gradient density to guide expert specialization. By penalizing incompatible expert assignments with density-aware weighting, PATR reduces the dominance of frequent optimization signals in router training. Furthermore, Routing-Guided Semantic Alignment (RGSA) transfers the pattern-specific knowledge learned by the router to cross-modal alignment through mutual information maximization, preserving distinctive temporal information across different patterns. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of IMRouter, particularly in improving forecasting performance on less frequent temporal patterns.

summary.takeaway: 提出IMRouter，针对LLM时间序列预测中的时间模式不平衡问题，通过模式自适应路由和路由引导的语义对齐，提升低频模式的预测表现。
summary.methods: 引入Pattern-Adaptive Temporal Representation Learning（PATR），利用梯度冲突和局部梯度密度指导专家专业化，并以密度感知加权惩罚不兼容的专家分配；通过Routing-Guided Semantic Alignment（RGSA）以互信息最大化将路由学到的模式知识迁移到跨模态对齐。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型、检索增强与对齐、自监督与表示学习及跨模态理解与生成相关，关注LLM用于时间序列预测时的跨模态对齐与不平衡优化。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅说明在基准数据集上有效，未给出具体误差数值、基线对比和计算开销；TPI现象的实证分析范围及对真实Web应用的泛化性未详细说明。

papers.title: Surprise Alone Learns Lies: Evidence-Gated Continual Learning for LLMs from Streaming Claims
papers.abstract: Continual learning methods for large language models increasingly decide what to learn by surprise, keeping the inputs the model finds least predictable. This rule is unsafe when the stream contains lies. A planted falsehood about something the model knows has low probability under the model's belief, so it is highly surprising by construction, and a surprise-driven learner absorbs nearly every such lie, at a rate similar to random selection with the same budget. We study the problem with LoRA-adapted students (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.2-3B) that learn from a stream of true and false claims about invented people and real CounterFact facts. We report four findings. (1) A verifier key, a judge that must approve each claim, removes lies to the extent that its verifier is accurate; real LLM judges are cautious and reject unsourced truths and even source-backed updates. (2) Calibrated regression tests on unrelated knowledge slow learning down without filtering out lies. (3) The original model's own prior flags claims that contradict what it knows, without a judge. It separates lies about known facts from true new facts (AUC 0.78-0.83 across three models) but not from legitimate updates of the same kind of fact (AUC 0.53). It saves 43% of judge calls, but an attacker with access to the model can choose lies that pass it. (4) If trusted sources exist that an attacker cannot plant, routing contradicted claims to evidence recovers legitimate updates and the combined system has the lowest poison rate among learned claims; when an attacker plants matching sources for 30% of the lies, the system ends up worse than the judge alone. The acceptance signals answer different questions, and none of them decides on its own whether a claim is true.

summary.takeaway: 指出以“惊讶度”驱动持续学习在含虚假声明的流数据中不安全，并比较验证器或裁判、校准回归测试、模型自身先验标记、可信来源证据路由等接受信号的过滤效果。
summary.methods: 用 LoRA 适配的 Qwen2.5-1.5B、Qwen2.5-3B、Llama-3.2-3B 学生模型，从关于虚构人物和真实 CounterFact 事实的真假声明流中学习，比较不同接受信号对谎言吸收和合法更新的影响。
summary.relevance: 直接面向大语言模型的持续学习，研究流式声明中如何选择学习内容，涉及知识更新与虚假信息过滤。
summary.caveat: 摘要为预印本自述结果，未给出各信号完整实验设置与统计细节；其中 AUC、节省裁判调用比例和毒化率结论需查原文核实。

papers.title: Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?
papers.abstract: Vision-language models can get individual judgments right while struggling to recover and consistently use the exact properties of a 3D object. To characterize this gap, we introduce BedBench, a controlled benchmark of thirteen procedurally generated tasks spanning individual judgments and composite answers. Across twelve open-weight and four frontier models, per-color counting exposes a pronounced weakness: humans achieve 93.3% accuracy, compared with 7.2% for the best model. Targeted fine-tuning raises one model's accuracy from 3.0% to 68.6%, but reveals a further difficulty: its answers about the most common colors remain inconsistent with its own per-color counts. Supplying those counts as text improves its judgments, showing that recovering a property does not mean using it consistently. Reasoning, scaling, and added visual cues each improve individual judgments, but none makes exact answers reliable. To locate the difficulty, we probe Qwen3.5-27B: exact per-color counts remain recoverable at the language model's input, yet the model's answers rarely recover them (65.0% for the probe vs. 3.0% for the model). Image-removal controls further show that some apparent successes require no visual evidence. These findings motivate evaluating 3D reasoning by exact correctness, consistent use, and image dependence, rather than accuracy alone. Code and dataset are publicly available: https://github.com/leduckhai/BedBench

summary.takeaway: 提出 BedBench，系统评估视觉语言模型对 3D 物体属性的精确恢复与一致使用能力，发现单项判断改善不等于组合回答可靠。
summary.methods: 构建 13 个程序化生成任务、覆盖单项判断与组合答案的受控基准，评测 12 个开放权重模型和 4 个前沿模型，并做微调、文本提示、探测和去图像控制实验。
summary.relevance: 属于多模态学习与跨模态理解评估，关注视觉语言模型在 3D 推理中的能力边界。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告了具体准确率与探测结果，但基准生成方式和模型清单细节未展开；结论主要限于该基准与所测模型。

papers.title: Neopep: Reinforcement Learning From Machine-Learned Force Field Energy for Non-Canonical Peptide Structure Prediction
papers.abstract: Peptide therapeutics occupy a compelling middle ground between small molecules and larger proteins, and in practice, most approved peptide drugs incorporate non-canonical amino acids (ncAAs) or other non-peptidic chemistries to elicit improved physiochemical properties (Yaseen Khan et al. (2026)). The chemical space of known ncAAs numbers in the thousands, yet current state-of-theart sequence-to-structure prediction models handle them poorly, because fewer than 0.02% of residues deposited in the Protein Data Bank (PDB) (Berman et al. (2003)), the main source of training data, correspond to ncAAs. Our central idea is that this data bottleneck can be overcome by coupling generative structure prediction with reinforcement learning (RL) from machine-learned force field (MLFF)-derived energy. We present Neopep, a sequence-conditioned diffusion model for ncAA-containing peptide structure prediction, first pretrained on PDB structures to establish a structural prior and then fine-tuned via RL: for ncAAcontaining peptide sequences, the model proposes structures that are scored by a frozen MLFF, and this energy signal is backpropagated directly into the model to progressively lower the energy of its predictions. MLFFs have demonstrated near-quantum accuracy across much of chemical space, approacing DFT-level accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost (Kabylda et al. (2025)). This makes them substantially more accurate than classical, empirically derived force fields, which are parametrised for the canonical 20 amino acids and do not generalise to arbitrary chemistries. While Neopep is trained on a fixed set of 189 ncAAs, the underlying architecture operates at atom-level granularity and is in principle generalisable to any chemistry. We show that our model is able to produce structures of ncAA-containing peptides that achieve lower RMSD values on average to the ground truth structures, in comparison to without finetuning and other state-of the-art structure prediction models.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Neopep，将序列条件扩散结构预测与基于机器学习力场能量的强化学习结合，用于含非天然氨基酸肽的结构预测。
summary.methods: 在 PDB 结构上预训练扩散模型建立结构先验，再对含非天然氨基酸肽序列采样结构并用冻结的 MLFF 打分，将该能量信号回传微调模型；训练覆盖 189 种非天然氨基酸。
summary.relevance: 涉及强化学习与生成式结构预测，面向训练数据稀缺的化学空间；与检索增强主题关联较弱，主要贡献在结构生成与 RL 优化。
summary.caveat: 摘要称平均 RMSD 优于未微调和其他先进模型，但未给出具体数值、测试集规模和统计检验；泛化到任意化学空间仅为原理性表述。

papers.title: GistRank: Gist-Compressed Listwise Ranking with Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become a powerful tool for listwise relevance ranking, which can improve web search by comparing retrieved passages jointly. However, processing every candidate verbatim and generating a permutation autoregressively can make inference costly, every candidate must be serialized verbatim into the prompt and the input therefore grows linearly with both the number and the length of the passages. While sliding-window ranking handles context limits through repeated re-encoding of overlapping blocks, hard compression techniques sacrifice the fine-grained details required for accurate discriminative judgment. To better understand and mitigate this trade-off, we conduct a comprehensive study of soft compression for LLM-based listwise ranking. Our findings reveal that a vanilla gist representation is ill-suited to ranking for two reasons: strictly causal encoding weakens how thoroughly each gist token absorbs its passage, and the representation is never trained to expose the relative-preference structure that separates closely competing candidates. To this end, we propose GistRank, a three-stage training framework that equips a large language model with gist-compressed passage representations by learning faithful gist tokens under a semi-bidirectional attention scheme, instilling discriminative comparison through pairwise training, and adapting the model to the listwise objective. GistRank collapses each passage into only $K{=}4$ gist tokens, this gives 14$\times$ speedups over one-shot full-text ranking while reaching 59.17 average nDCG@10 over TREC DL19/20 and five BEIR subsets within 0.89 of the strongest full-context baseline. Overall, GistRank provides an effective means to enhance efficiency for searches in real-world environments.

summary.takeaway: 提出 GistRank，通过半双向注意力学习忠实 gist token、成对训练注入判别比较能力并适配 listwise 排序目标，以压缩表示降低 LLM 排序推理成本。
summary.methods: 研究 LLM listwise 排序的软压缩，将每段文本压缩为 K=4 个 gist token，采用三阶段训练；在 TREC DL19/20 和五个 BEIR 子集上评测。
summary.relevance: 属于大语言模型用于检索排序与对齐，直接关系检索增强中的高效重排。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告 14 倍加速和平均 nDCG@10 为 59.17、与最强全上下文基线差 0.89，但需注意其效率与效果权衡依赖所测数据集和基线选择。

papers.title: Category-Anchored Large Language Models for Next POI Recommendation
papers.abstract: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation aims to predict a user's next destination from spatio-temporal check-in data, and serves as the foundation for many location-based services. Recent advances incorporate large language models (LLMs) into this task by textualizing user trajectories to exploit their semantic reasoning ability. However, directly generating POI identifiers with such models is unreliable: POIs are sparse, localized, and long-tailed entities with weak natural-language semantics, which creates a semantic-to-entity gap between high-level mobility intent and concrete POI prediction. To bridge this gap, we propose ANCHOR, a category-anchored framework for semantic-to-entity grounding in next POI recommendation. Specifically, ANCHOR first estimates category-level mobility intent in a compact and stable semantic space, rather than predicting concrete POI entities directly. The inferred intent is then grounded into a candidate set by integrating three complementary sources of mobility evidence: category anchors, historical visit memory, and user preferences. Finally, a history-aware reranker selects the target POI by matching each candidate with the user's historical mobility patterns and current context. Experiments on three real-world check-in datasets show that ANCHOR consistently outperforms representative traditional, structure-enhanced, and LLM-based baselines on the reported metrics. Further analyses validate the effectiveness of semantic-to-entity grounding and show favorable trade-offs among candidate coverage, ranking quality, and inference efficiency.

summary.takeaway: 提出 ANCHOR，以类别为锚点先推断类别级移动意图，再结合类别锚点、历史访问记忆和用户偏好 grounding 到候选集，最后用历史感知重排器选择 POI。
summary.methods: 在三个真实签到数据集上，将用户轨迹文本化并利用 LLM 估计类别级意图，融合三类移动证据生成候选，再由历史感知重排器排序；与传统、结构增强和 LLM 基线比较。
summary.relevance: 属于大语言模型与检索增强式候选生成在时空推荐中的应用，缓解语义到实体之间的鸿沟。
summary.caveat: 摘要称在报告指标上一致优于基线，但未给出具体指标数值和数据集名称；候选覆盖、排序质量与推理效率的权衡细节需查原文。

papers.title: What Makes Medical Examination Items Difficult? Using Large Language Models to Explore Patterns Associated With Empirical Item Difficulty
papers.abstract: Research on medical item difficulty has largely focused on prediction rather than on identifying interpretable patterns associated with empirical difficulty. This study used empirical difficulty labels to guide large language models (LLMs) in inducing difficulty rubrics and examined how rubric guidance affected LLM difficulty judgments. Using training items and their empirical difficulty estimates from the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) and the Physician Assistant National Certifying Examination (PANCE), Claude Opus 5 induced separate rubrics for absolute and pairwise difficulty judgment. None of the induced rubrics treated surface features, such as stem length, option count, or images, as major sources of difficulty. Several patterns emerged across both examinations, including cue convergence, misleading cues, and option competition, although their specific forms differed. Retrieval of knowledge that could not be derived from the stem was particularly prominent in the PANCE rubrics, whereas the USMLE rubrics placed greater emphasis on integrating multiple clinical cues. We compared commercial and open-weight LLMs on held-out items under unguided and rubric-guided conditions. Rubric guidance changed how models used the difficulty scale but did not consistently improve performance. In absolute judgments, guidance encouraged broader use of the scale and generally improved coarse-grained agreement, without consistently improving rank ordering. In pairwise comparisons, its effects varied across models and examinations, and judgments became more sensitive to presentation order. These findings suggest that the value of label-guided rubric induction may lie more in generating interpretable, testable hypotheses from empirical difficulty data than in reliably improving difficulty judgments.

summary.takeaway: 利用经验难度标签引导 LLM 归纳可解释的医学试题难度评分规则，并检验规则引导对难度判断的影响；规则引导改变量表使用方式，但未稳定提升判断表现。
summary.methods: 使用 USMLE 和 PANCE 训练题及其经验难度估计，由 Claude Opus 5 分别归纳绝对难度和成对难度判断规则；在留出题上比较商业与开放权重模型在无引导和有规则引导下的表现。
summary.relevance: 属于大语言模型在医学教育评估中的应用，涉及可解释模式发现与模型判断可靠性。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明样本量、模型完整清单和效应量；规则引导对排序和成对比较的效果因模型与考试而异，且成对判断更受呈现顺序影响。

papers.title: SocialArena: Evaluating Social Intelligence in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: We introduce SocialArena, a benchmark for systematically defining and evaluating the social intelligence of large language models (LLMs). Although LLMs are increasingly deployed in socially interactive applications such as mental health counseling, companionship chatbots, and educational tutoring, existing evaluations remain fragmented focusing on isolated capabilities or single scenarios and evaluation reliability is largely unverified. This work makes three main contributions to address these limitations. (1) We first propose a unified three-tier framework that defines social intelligence along three capability dimensions: role-playing ability, mental state reasoning, and behavioral reasoning. To operationalize this definition, we design a role-playing dialogue paradigm with explicit character thinking for evaluation, enabling simultaneous assessment of these capabilities in a manner that mirrors realistic human interactions. (2) To ensure diversity across social scenarios and thereby prevent evaluation conclusions from being confined to specific scenarios, we introduce the U-TRIMF framework, which guides us in synthesizing social contexts with broad coverage. (3) To obtain reliable evaluation, we invest $132.4K to recruit and train human annotators and adopt a human-annotated arena-style protocol, where annotators compare model responses and provide preference labels along with natural-language critiques. We hope that SocialArena can provide valuable insights and guidance for future LLM improvements.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SocialArena 基准与三层社会智能框架，从角色扮演、心理状态推理和行为推理三方面评估 LLM，并采用人工标注的竞技场式偏好协议。
summary.methods: 设计带显式角色思考的角色扮演对话范式，用 U-TRIMF 框架合成多样社会场景，投入 13.24 万美元招募培训标注者，收集模型回复的偏好标签与自然语言评语。
summary.relevance: 属于大语言模型评估与对齐，关注社会交互场景中的能力测量和评价可靠性。
summary.caveat: 摘要强调人工标注投入，但未报告基准规模、标注者一致性和模型间具体结果；竞技场偏好标签的可靠性仍需原文验证。

papers.title: From Local Recovery to Unified Generation: Discovering Triple Set in Knowledge Graphs via Observation-Anchored Latent Diffusion
papers.abstract: Triple set prediction (TSP) is to recover missing relational triples in a knowledge graph by predicting the triple set instead of isolated links. Existing approaches predominantly rely on the subgraph-based completion paradigm, where the original graph is first partitioned into local subgraphs which are then independently completed. Such a paradigm suffers from fragmented structural reasoning, limited cross subgraph dependency modeling, and missing predictions across subgraphs. This paper proposes LatentDiff, a novel unified latent generative framework for TSP, which reformulates knowledge graph completion as latent space graph generation. LatentDiff first learns a compact latent representation using a relation-aware residual-quantized knowledge graph autoencoder, which encodes the whole graph into relation-aware latent embeddings, quantizes them with chunked residual codebooks, and reconstructs triples through a factorized decoder. On top of this latent space, we introduce an observation-anchored latent graph diffusion model, where the target latent graph representation is perturbed toward the observed latent. The reverse process recovers missing triples through progressive latent denoising. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that LatentDiff outperforms the SOTA in terms of F_{tsp} by 5.4 percentage points on average. Code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LKGDiff-44A5.

summary.takeaway: 提出 LatentDiff，将知识图谱三元组集合预测重构为潜在空间图生成，用关系感知残差量化自编码器和观测锚定潜在扩散统一恢复缺失三元组。
summary.methods: 先学习关系感知残差量化知识图谱自编码器，将整图编码为潜在表示并用分块残差码本量化、因子化解码重建三元组；再在潜在空间做以观测潜在为锚的扩散去噪；在三个基准数据集上评测。
summary.relevance: 属于知识图谱补全与检索增强相关知识组织，强调跨子图统一生成而非局部子图独立补全。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告 F_tsp 平均提升 5.4 个百分点，但未给出数据集名称、基线细节和方差；代码链接为匿名仓库，复现性需进一步确认。

papers.title: TaxoMFM: A Taxonomy-Aware Foundation Model for the Human Gut Microbiome
papers.abstract: Existing gut microbiome foundation models typically use flat taxon representations, limiting their ability to exploit known taxonomic hierarchies. We introduce TaxoMFM, a microbiome foundation model that integrates taxonomic structure into self-supervised learning. TaxoMFM jointly learns abundance patterns across taxonomic ranks and relative proportions within groups through taxonomy-aware encoding and hierarchical compositional reconstruction. We further construct TaxoGut-HPP, comprising 100,806 gut microbiome profiles from 231 source cohorts and covering 40 classification and 8 regression tasks. TaxoMFM achieves competitive performance across disease, gut health, host trait, and liver ultrasound phenotype prediction. In cross-cohort zero-shot transfer, where target cohorts are excluded from both pretraining and downstream adaptation, TaxoMFM achieves AUROCs of 0.838, 0.736, and 0.722 for colorectal cancer, type 2 diabetes, and inflammatory bowel disease, respectively. Further analyses show that TaxoMFM recovers community changes across taxonomic scales, while preserving community information and producing consistent representations under database updates and species-vocabulary shifts. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TaxoMFM-F16D/.

summary.takeaway: 提出TaxoMFM，将分类层级结构融入自监督学习，构建肠道微生物组基础模型，并发布大规模TaxoGut-HPP数据集，在跨队列零样本迁移任务中表现良好。
summary.methods: 采用分类感知编码与层级成分重建，联合学习各分类层级丰度模式与组内相对比例；构建TaxoGut-HPP数据集（100,806个肠道微生物组样本、231个来源队列，覆盖40个分类与8个回归任务）；在疾病、肠道健康、宿主性状和肝脏超声表型预测上评估。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于预训练与自监督表示学习，面向微生物组基础模型，与给定研究主题中的预训练和自监督表示学习直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告竞争性表现与部分零样本AUROC，未提供与具体基线的系统对比和统计显著性；数据集来源与标注质量细节未展开。

papers.title: TabCUQ: Context-Uncertainty Quantification for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Tabular foundation models use in-context learning to estimate conditional expected outcomes and average treatment effects for specific groups of individuals. Using these estimates to guide scientific decisions requires reliable uncertainty quantification. The challenge is to account simultaneously for two sources of uncertainty: limited-context bias and context variation arising from the small labeled sample supplied at inference. Predictive spread does not directly quantify both sources of uncertainty, and we observe that the ordinary bootstrap may substantially overestimate context variation, whereas subsampling may underestimate it. We introduce TabCUQ, a perturbation-based framework that injects noise into observed outcomes and applies the foundation model to the perturbed contexts. TabCUQ estimates context variation using wild-bootstrap dispersion and accounts for limited-context bias using the maximum deviation between perturbed and original estimates. For a kernel-regression analogue whose estimation error admits an exact decomposition into these two components, we show that our framework provides asymptotically valid pointwise coverage. In simulations, TabCUQ substantially improves coverage, with average interval widths typically about twice those of an oracle bias-aware benchmark. Across seven real-world tasks, it also improves coverage of reference functions learned from much larger samples.

summary.takeaway: 提出TabCUQ，针对表格基础模型上下文学习中的不确定性量化，同时估计有限上下文偏差与上下文变异两类不确定性。
summary.methods: 基于扰动框架，向观测结果注入噪声并让基础模型处理扰动后的上下文；用wild-bootstrap离散度估计上下文变异，用扰动估计与原始估计的最大偏差刻画有限上下文偏差；对核回归类比给出渐近逐点覆盖性，并在模拟和七个真实任务上评估。
summary.relevance: 与检索增强、对齐及预训练主题相关，因其关注基础模型推理阶段上下文样本带来的不确定性，对可靠决策有方法学意义。
summary.caveat: 理论保证仅针对核回归类比，未证明一般表格基础模型的覆盖性；区间宽度约为oracle基准两倍，存在精度与覆盖率的权衡。

papers.title: SCARL: Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning by scoring sampled responses with a rule-based verifier and reinforcing those that pass. Where a classifier's training couples predicted probability to labels, nothing ties an RLVR policy's confidence in a response to its reward: aligned training would drive responses with the same advantage toward equal confidence, yet the advantage is blind to confidence. Under this sequence-confidence misalignment, a success the policy barely found earns the same update as one it produces with near certainty, and a confident error is corrected no harder than an exploratory one. We propose SCARL (Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning), which reshapes, but never re-signs, each advantage with the alignment gap between the response's group-relative confidence and the outcome its advantage certifies, normalized into shares of each class's advantage budget. Misaligned samples absorb the force, responses with the same advantage are driven toward equal confidence, and repairing the misalignment doubles as a remedy for the entropy collapse that erodes exploration. SCARL provably reduces to its base estimator when a class's confidences agree, adds no extra passes and one hyperparameter. On Qwen3-4B-Base it lifts average Pass@32 by 2.4 points over DAPO and is best among nine compute-matched methods on both coverage and per-draw accuracy; applied unchanged across four estimators and four backbones, it improves 14 of 16 settings while preserving policy entropy and widening the confidence-correctness separation. Our code is available at https://github.com/kezhh163/scarl.

summary.takeaway: 提出SCARL，通过序列置信度与优势对齐重塑强化学习优势，缓解置信度-奖励错配并改善探索。
summary.methods: 用响应组内相对置信度与优势所认证结果之间的对齐差距归一化后重塑（不改变符号）各优势；在Qwen3-4B-Base上以RLVR训练，与DAPO等九种算力匹配方法比较，并在四种估计器和四种骨干模型上验证。
summary.relevance: 直接对应强化学习与对齐主题，涉及可验证奖励强化学习中的优势估计与策略置信度对齐。
summary.caveat: 实验主要围绕Qwen3-4B-Base及特定可验证奖励任务，摘要未说明在其他任务类型或更大模型上的泛化边界；理论性质限于与基础估计器在类内置信度一致时等价。

papers.title: From MS/MS evidence to adaptive spectroscopic characterization: Reinforcement learning guided by candidate molecular structures
papers.abstract: Small-molecule identification from tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) may require complementary measurements. Herein, we propose a structure-informed deep Q-network (SI-DQN) that uses existing MS/MS evidence to decide whether further characterization is needed, which measurement to request, and when to stop. The policy combines spectral representations and candidate rankings with score-weighted descriptors of the candidates' chemical features and structural differences. The policy was evaluated on 79,462 held-out samples with simulated MS/MS, infrared (IR), and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectra from the Multimodal Spectroscopic Dataset. Evaluation used fixed hard candidate sets containing the correct structure and equal normalized acquisition costs. Averaged across three training runs, SI-DQN increased Top-1 accuracy from 80.10% to 93.78% for positive-ion MS/MS starts and from 70.44% to 93.31% for negative-ion starts. The corresponding mean additional measurement counts were only 0.227 and 0.340 per sample, respectively. Complete acquisition achieved 97.72% accuracy with four additions, whereas SI-DQN reduced the additional measurement count by 94.3% and 91.5%. Relative to a rule-based policy, SI-DQN reduced the composite loss combining terminal ranking error and acquisition cost by 19.3% and 25.5%. Adding structural information to DQN further improved accuracy while reducing requests across all three training runs. At comparable ranking uncertainty, SI-DQN increased request rates relative to DQN more strongly in groups with high structural disagreement, where larger reductions in composite loss were also observed. Together, these results support using the ambiguity among candidate structures after MS/MS analysis to guide further characterization, providing a quantitative basis for balancing identification performance against subsequent measurement effort.

summary.takeaway: 提出结构信息深度Q网络SI-DQN，利用MS/MS证据与候选结构模糊性决定是否追加IR/NMR测量、选择哪种测量及何时停止。
summary.methods: 策略结合谱表示、候选排序及按分数加权的候选化学特征与结构差异描述；在Multimodal Spectroscopic Dataset的79,462个留出样本上，用模拟MS/MS、IR和NMR谱评估，采用固定难候选集和归一化采集成本。
summary.relevance: 属于强化学习引导的自适应实验设计，与强化学习主题相关，并涉及多模态谱学证据融合。
summary.caveat: 使用模拟谱而非真实实验谱；评估限于固定难候选集与归一化成本假设，实际实验噪声与成本结构可能不同。

papers.title: Revisiting Over-refusal in Safety-aligned Large Language Models: A Representation and Optimization Perspective
papers.abstract: Over-refusal is a critical side effect of safety alignment in large language models (LLMs), causing harmless but superficially risky queries to be mistakenly rejected. Despite the effectiveness of existing mitigation methods, why safety-aligned LLMs may still reject harmless queries under correct safety supervision remains insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we analyze over-refusal through the lens of representation and optimization. We make two observations: 1) the representations of harmful and over-refusal samples are visually distinguishable at certain intermediate layers but increasingly overlap in deeper layers; and 2) harmful-sample gradients exhibit high intra-class similarity and concentrate in a low-rank subspace. Moreover, they are more strongly aligned with refusal-target gradients than with correct helpful-target gradients on over-refusal prompts. This imbalanced gradient coupling can bias over-refusal samples toward refusal, while the reduced apparent representational separation in deeper layers may make it more difficult for the model to maintain a clear boundary between harmful and over-refusal samples. To this end, we propose GOAL (Gradient Orthogonalization with contrAstive Learning), a safety-alignment framework for mitigating over-refusal. Specifically, GOAL consists of two components: 1) to prevent imbalanced gradient coupling from biasing the optimization of over-refusal samples toward refusal, we orthogonalize over-refusal gradients against the low-rank refusal subspace extracted from harmful gradients; and 2) to explicitly enhance the separation between harmful and over-refusal representations, we introduce a contrastive learning objective. Extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks demonstrate that GOAL effectively mitigates over-refusal while preserving safety performance and general capabilities.

summary.takeaway: 从表示与优化角度分析安全对齐模型过度拒答的成因，并提出GOAL框架在保持安全性的同时缓解过度拒答。
summary.methods: 观察有害样本与过度拒答样本在中间层可区分、深层重叠，且有害样本梯度低秩集中并与拒答目标梯度更对齐；GOAL对过度拒答梯度作低秩拒答子空间正交化，并加入对比学习目标增强表示分离；在多个模型与基准上实验。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型及自监督表示学习主题相关，涉及安全对齐中的表示分析与优化干预。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体量化提升幅度与基准名称；分析基于所观察模型的层间表示现象，是否普遍适用于不同架构与对齐流程仍有待验证。

papers.title: DeCoRL: Decomposed Consistency Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Image Composition
papers.abstract: Multi-image composition (MICo) is a critical yet challenging capability for large-scale image editing models, where consistency degrades rapidly as the number of reference images increases. While supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can equip models with basic MICo ability, it provides only implicit supervision on the composed image and often fails to learn reliable object-level correspondence across multiple references. We propose DeCoRL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that improves MICo consistency by decomposing holistic MICo consistency into object-level consistency. DeCoRL first establishes instruction-relevant object correspondences across reference images and localizes the corresponding regions in the generated image. It then uses a VLM-based reward model trained on single-object consistency annotations to produce fine-grained, object-wise feedback, which is aggregated into a multi-object consistency reward to guide RL post-training. We further introduce DeCo-Bench, a benchmark covering compositions from 2 to 6 reference images. Experiments on DeCo-Bench and the public MICo-Bench demonstrate consistent improvements in MICo consistency.

summary.takeaway: 提出DeCoRL，将多图组合的整体一致性分解为对象级一致性，用强化学习后训练提升多参考图组合的一致性。
summary.methods: 先建立跨参考图的指令相关对象对应并定位生成图中对应区域，再用基于单对象一致性标注训练的VLM奖励模型给出对象级反馈，聚合成多对象一致性奖励指导RL后训练；构建覆盖2至6张参考图的DeCo-Bench。
summary.relevance: 与强化学习及对齐主题相关，涉及以奖励模型引导的生成模型后训练。
summary.caveat: 依赖VLM奖励模型与对象对应定位的准确性，摘要未报告其失败模式；评估限于图像组合一致性，未涉及其他编辑能力。

papers.title: Reasoning or Pattern Exploitation? Mechanistic Insights from RL-Trained Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly described as acquiring "reasoning" skills after reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. However, whether these gains reflect genuine reasoning or more superficial adaptations remains underexplored. In this work, we probe LLMs trained in a finite and exhaustively analyzable logical domain, namely Tic-Tac-Toe, and trace how internal representations evolve across reinforcement learning (RL) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Quantitatively, RL yields high accuracy and robustness across prompt variations, suggesting the emergence of game reasoning. Mechanistic interpretability, however, paints a different picture: features extracted with sparse autoencoders (SAEs) reveal that models primarily adapt to rely more heavily on information already explicit in the prompt, such as whose turn it is, game progression and board occupancy. In comparison, high-level concepts like board symmetries and strategic forks remain weakly represented, raising concerns that reasoning benchmarks overestimate model abilities. This suggests that RL-driven "reasoning" may conflate task-specific adaptations to input information with reasoning ability. We provide, for the first time: (i) a systematic interpretability pipeline tracing representation dynamics across RL training in small-scale LLMs; (ii) an extension of SAE-based feature discovery to hypothesis-driven testing in a finite logical domain; and (iii) an interpretability-based demonstration that RL post-training neither adds nor removes concept information but reorganizes which features dominate the representation, with causal interventions locating the decision downstream of it, in the late-layer state.

summary.takeaway: 在井字棋有限逻辑域中发现，RL后训练带来的高准确率更多体现为对提示中显式信息的依赖，而非高层策略概念的形成。
summary.methods: 用GRPO训练小型LLM，结合稀疏自编码器提取特征并进行假设驱动测试与因果干预，追踪RL训练过程中内部表示的动态变化。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型与强化学习主题，对理解RL训练后“推理”能力的本质与评测效度有启示。
summary.caveat: 研究限于井字棋这一有限且可穷举的逻辑域和小规模模型，结论向开放域推理任务的推广需谨慎。

papers.title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
papers.abstract: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. It treats verification as dynamic evidence gathering and assessment within a shared procedure for online and offline settings across platforms and observation modalities. After inspecting the available context to construct a task rubric, the verifier selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements and combines their findings under explicit evidence rules. Experiments show improved agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines across these settings, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online. Further analyses connect these gains to complementary evidence and test-time exploration.

summary.takeaway: 提出VeriCUA，将计算机使用智能体的任务完成验证建模为智能体式探索，跨平台统一在线与离线验证流程。
summary.methods: 验证器先检查可用上下文构建任务评分标准，再针对未解决要求选择GUI或代码检查，并按显式证据规则综合发现；在桌面、移动和网页环境及多种观测模态下与基线比较。
summary.relevance: 与强化学习及多模态学习主题相关，验证器可用于数据筛选、评估和强化学习奖励，涉及视觉语言模型与图形界面理解。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称与参考标签一致性提升，未给出具体数值；验证效果依赖可执行的GUI或代码检查能力，复杂环境下证据获取可能受限。

papers.title: SymAnt: Grounding Long-Horizon Action Anticipation with Adaptable Symbolic Priors
papers.abstract: As robots and intelligent systems increasingly interact with humans, they must anticipate long sequences of future actions from only brief observations. While purely neural models typically require extensive observations to predict future actions and remain difficult to interpret and adjust, symbolic priors offer a structured alternative. To this end, we introduce SymAnt, a novel neuro-symbolic approach that unifies the expressiveness of neural networks with the structured reasoning of scene and knowledge graphs. Given a short video, SymAnt performs a joint-search over both graphs to construct a symbolic context, enabling unified reasoning over spatial relationships, object attributes, affordances, and associated actions. This symbolic context serves as a prior for an iterative refinement process that progressively generates and improves the sequence of future actions. By grounding predictions in symbolic context, SymAnt anticipates long-horizon actions from short observation windows in a parameter-efficient manner, while enabling users to directly edit the underlying knowledge to adjust predictions without further training. Through our experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of SymAnt, particularly when only short observation contexts are available, across five diverse datasets: Breakfast, 50 Salads, EPIC-KITCHENS, EGTEA Gaze+, and Assembly101.

summary.takeaway: 提出神经符号方法SymAnt，利用场景图与知识图谱构建符号上下文作为先验，从短观测窗口预测长程动作序列，并允许用户直接编辑知识以调整预测而无需再训练。
summary.methods: 对短视频联合搜索场景图与知识图谱生成符号上下文，覆盖空间关系、物体属性、可供性与动作；以此为先验迭代精炼未来动作序列；在Breakfast、50 Salads、EPIC-KITCHENS、EGTEA Gaze+、Assembly101五个数据集上实验。
summary.relevance: 与知识图谱主题直接相关，展示了图谱构建与符号表示如何作为先验支撑推理与预测。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体量化指标与各数据集上的对比细节；用户可编辑知识带来的实际效果仅作定性描述。

papers.title: Beyond LLM Wrappers: Context Engineering and the Three-Engine Architecture for Reliable Financial AI
papers.abstract: Financial AI systems must support decision-bearing questions involving payments, collections, cash flow, and compliance while ensuring numerical accuracy, traceability, and auditability. Large language models (LLMs) enable natural language interaction but cannot independently guarantee reproducible calculations or evidence-grounded recommendations. We present a production-grounded architecture integrating three components: a financial knowledge graph for enterprise relationships, temporal context, and provenance; a deterministic optimization engine for financial calculations and decisions; and a multi-agent LLM layer for intent interpretation, task orchestration, explanation, and claim validation. A coordination layer, termed context engineering, selects, ranks, composes, and validates query-specific context across ERP systems, tools, and tenants. Based on observations from 15 deployments over approximately 11 months, single-agent pipelines exhibited hallucination rates of about 7-9% (5-10% across query types), including invented invoices and unsupported financial claims. Graph-backed multi-agent validation reduced observed rates to below 1%, although these findings are observational rather than causal. ERP data quality and tenant-specific schemas remained major implementation challenges. Reusable mappings, graph templates, and validation policies coincided with a reduction in deployment time from roughly six to two weeks. We argue that financial context engineering extends beyond text-centric retrieval-augmented generation by requiring structured relationships, temporal validity, exact numerical evidence, access controls, and validation against source records and solver outputs. We outline research challenges in evaluation, reproducibility, privacy, context quality, and cross-tenant generalization.

summary.takeaway: 提出面向金融AI的三引擎架构：金融知识图谱、确定性优化引擎与多智能体LLM层，并由上下文工程协调选择、排序、组合与验证查询相关上下文。
summary.methods: 基于15个部署、约11个月的观察性数据；用图谱支持的多智能体验证降低幻觉率，从单智能体管线的约7-9%降至1%以下；复用映射、图模板与验证策略。
summary.relevance: 同时涉及大语言模型、检索增强与知识图谱，讨论结构化关系、时间有效性与数值证据对RAG的扩展。
summary.caveat: 作者明确称发现为观察性而非因果；ERP数据质量与租户特定schema仍是主要实施挑战。

papers.title: ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender
papers.abstract: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This brittleness has a mechanistic root: Alignment is shallow, with safety behavior concentrated in a model's first few output tokens, and existing defenses inherit the weakness, supervising the surface form of the response without ever giving the model an explicit safety decision to learn. We take the opposite view of shallowness: if a short span determines the trajectory of an entire response, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first. We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Because the decision is a token span, the reward can be a rule: a self-verified reward checks the committed label against the conversation's known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, while the same format also supports an LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, maintaining their lead in safety while preserving utility at a modest cost to helpfulness. A per-token KL analysis and interventional probes confirm why this works: training concentrates its effect on the brief deliberation that sets a response's trajectory, and the decision committed there is a causal control point. The very shallowness attackers exploit becomes the mechanism of defense.

summary.takeaway: 提出Assess→Decide→Respond框架，让防御方在生成回复前先提交显式可解析的安全决策，利用安全对齐集中于前几个token的“浅层性”作为防御干预点。
summary.methods: 在payload轮用强化学习训练决策承诺；采用自验证规则奖励（无需judge与标注），也支持LLM-as-judge的分级决策奖励；在两个模型族、覆盖安全/效用/有用性的十四个基准上评测，并做逐token KL分析与干预探针。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型安全对齐及强化学习方法直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要称以牺牲部分helpfulness为代价换取安全性领先，但未给出具体数值；方法效果依赖对话已知性质用于自验证奖励。

papers.title: TaskFrame: Connecting Task-Level Planning with Frame-Level Control for Game Agents
papers.abstract: Building general game agents requires both high-level task reasoning and low-latency action control in rapidly changing visual environments. These capabilities favor models with substantially different computational profiles, making them difficult to realize within a single model. In this work, we present TaskFrame, a hierarchical planner-controller framework that connects task-level planning with frame-level keyboard-and-mouse control. A vision-language task planner decomposes a high-level goal into an ordered sequence of atomic instructions and is optimized through supervised learning and dependency-aware GRPO. The hidden states of special goal tokens that terminate each atomic instruction provide continuous goal embeddings that are cached and reused across control steps. A causal Transformer controller combines the embedding of the active goal with recent observations to predict discrete keyboard and mouse-button actions and continuous camera motion at every game step. We train the system in three stages: planner training, controller pretraining, and joint alignment. Experiments in Minecraft show that TaskFrame is competitive with general-purpose vision-language models on instruction decomposition, and that in closed-loop evaluation the agent achieves a higher combat success rate than the evaluated baselines.

summary.takeaway: 提出分层规划器-控制器框架TaskFrame，将高层任务规划与帧级键鼠控制连接，用于游戏智能体。
summary.methods: 视觉语言任务规划器将目标分解为原子指令序列，经监督学习与依赖感知GRPO优化；目标token隐状态作为缓存的目标嵌入；因果Transformer控制器结合目标嵌入与近期观测预测离散按键与连续相机运动；三阶段训练：规划器训练、控制器预训练、联合对齐；在Minecraft上实验。
summary.relevance: 涉及预训练、多模态学习与跨模态理解生成，体现视觉语言模型与低层控制的衔接。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告在指令分解上与通用VLM具竞争力、闭环评测中战斗成功率高于所评估基线，未给出具体数值与基线范围。

papers.title: Mobilizing the Archive: Bitext Extraction at Scale from Archival Documents for Extremely Low-resource Languages
papers.abstract: While mining parallel sentences from web pages has proven effective for low-resource machine translation, the majority of the world's languages have little to no web presence. What they do have, though, are resources that are the result of centuries of efforts by linguists, such as grammars, dictionaries, and other documentation materials. We propose extracting translation examples from such linguistic resources, which offer parallel data for languages under-represented online and could potentially scale to thousands more languages. We develop a pipeline to achieve this, leveraging an Optical Character Recognition (OCR) model as well as a vision language model (VLM), to ensure identified content to be aligned with visual layout information. We demonstrate the utility of the extracted bitexts for bootstrapping translation systems across 20 languages, both by training machine translation models and by applying in-context learning for large language models. For in-context learning, we observe improvements of +15.78 and +6.94 chrF2++ over zero-shot translation for into low- and high-resource languages, respectively.

summary.takeaway: 提出从语言学文献（语法书、词典等）中大规模抽取平行句对，为网络资源极少的低资源语言获取翻译数据。
summary.methods: 构建结合OCR模型与VLM的流水线，使识别内容与视觉版式信息对齐；在20种语言上通过训练MT模型和LLM上下文学习验证抽取双语的效用。
summary.relevance: 连接大语言模型、检索增强与多模态学习，展示从文档图像中挖掘可用于对齐与翻译的数据。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出上下文学习相对零样本的chrF2++提升（低资源+15.78、高资源+6.94），未报告MT训练的具体结果与OCR/VLM错误的影响。

papers.title: Mind The Gap (MTG-AD): Dataset and Fine-grained Evaluation for End-to-End Inline Audio Descriptions
papers.abstract: Audio descriptions (AD) are essential for making visual media accessible to blind and low-vision (BLV) users. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a scalable solution for generating audio descriptions on-demand, their performance on ``inline'' audio descriptions -- which must fit within existing silences in a video -- remains under-explored, particularly for diverse user-generated content (UGC). We present a comprehensive investigation into MLLM-generated inline audio descriptions. First, we introduce MTG-AD, a professionally annotated dataset of 36 hours of videos, each averaging $\sim$5 mins. and 8k+ descriptions in total, co-created by paired blind and sighted AD professionals to provide a high-quality benchmark for this task. Second, we propose MTG-AD-Eval, an evaluation framework based on audio description expert guidelines that provides fine-grained, reference-free actionable metrics for model improvement. Crucially, our framework evaluates the end-to-end task: it renders the generated scripts into audio tracks to assess their fit within the original video's natural silences, minimizing disruptive overlaps. Our analysis across frontier MLLMs reveals that while models accurately describe visual events and substantially reduce speech overlaps, gaps persist in narrative pacing and flow. Finally, we empirically validate that our automated and reference-free metrics correlate significantly with human quality ratings from sighted raters and 7 BLV participants, finding that while users narrowly prefer human-authored audio descriptions, they find MLLM-generated audio descriptions highly beneficial for comprehension. We provide actionable system design guidance and release MTG-AD at https://hf.co/datasets/google/mind-the-gap-inline-ad and MTG-AD-Eval at https://github.com/google/mtg-ad.

summary.takeaway: 系统研究MLLM生成的内联音频描述，发布专业标注数据集MTG-AD与细粒度无参考评估框架MTG-AD-Eval。
summary.methods: MTG-AD含36小时视频、平均约5分钟、共8k+条描述，由盲人与明眼AD专业人员配对共创；评估将生成脚本渲染为音轨以检验其在原视频自然静默中的适配；对前沿MLLM分析，并与明眼评分者及7名BLV参与者的评分做相关性验证。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型、多模态学习及与人类偏好的对齐评估。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出模型在叙事节奏与流畅性上仍有差距；用户虽认为MLLM生成描述有益，但仍略偏好人工撰写的描述。

papers.title: Raincheck: Deferred Multimodal Prefill for Efficient Multi-Turn MLLM Inference
papers.abstract: Multi-turn conversations with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reuse input context, but long multimodal inputs increase time to first token (TTFT). Query-aware hard pruning reduces prefill tokens but permanently excludes information that later questions may require. We propose Raincheck, a framework for deferred multimodal prefill that decouples initial token selection from later information availability. An existing pruning method selects tokens for initial prefill; Raincheck preserves and progressively prefills unselected tokens in source order using unused compute capacity during decode. Unfinished prefill continues after answer return during available scheduling gaps. Attention visibility control and affine state mapping enable context updates after generation begins in full-attention and hybrid recurrent models. Prefill-decode fusion reduces repeated weight reads. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B and Qwen3.5-9B with 30% initial multimodal-token retention. Across both models and four pruning methods, Raincheck recovers on average 77.7% and 60.4% of the quality lost to matched hard pruning on MultiVerse and ConvBench, respectively. On MultiVerse, the SGLang implementation reduces mean first-turn TTFT by up to 24.1% relative to full prefill, with less than 0.5% increase in mean time per output token (TPOT).

summary.takeaway: 提出Raincheck，将多模态预填充推迟：先用剪枝方法选取初始token进行预填充，再在解码期间利用空闲算力按源顺序渐进预填充未选token，以兼顾TTFT与信息可用性。
summary.methods: 通过注意力可见性控制与仿射状态映射支持生成开始后的上下文更新（含全注意力与混合循环模型）；预填充-解码融合减少重复权重读取；在Qwen3-VL-8B与Qwen3.5-9B上以30%初始多模态token保留率评测，覆盖四种剪枝方法及MultiVerse、ConvBench。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型多轮推理及多模态上下文处理相关，涉及检索增强式的上下文利用。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告在MultiVerse与ConvBench上分别恢复匹配硬剪枝所损失质量的77.7%与60.4%，SGLang实现首轮TTFT最多降低24.1%，TPOT平均增加不到0.5%；结果限于所述模型与保留率设置。

papers.title: RADIOlogy: A Single-Pass Approach to Training-Free Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract: Current zero-shot anomaly detection methods often rely on complex prompt-learning techniques or computationally expensive sliding-window strategies to achieve fine-grained visual alignment to detect small-scale anomalies. This reliance stems from the fundamental limitation of standard CLIP architectures, where [CLS] token attention and spatial patch pooling struggle to capture subtle, localized anomaly features. While prompt-learning approaches aim to bridge this gap, they typically require a large number of ground-truth segmentation masks from auxiliary datasets, which are often unavailable in specialized domains. In this work, we show an emerging property of multi-head attention pooling in vision-language models: remarkable zero-shot anomaly localization and detection right out of the box. We translate this property into a single-pass anomaly detection technique, RADIOlogy, that does not require dense, windowed execution and significantly outperforms other training-free baselines. Instead, the method relies on a simple contrastive scoring approach that compares the average similarity between vision features and a suite of normal and abnormal prompts. Furthermore, we leverage the agglomerative features of RADIO models to enhance pixel-level anomaly segmentation using a dense anomaly refinement pipeline. Finally, we show how the vision-language family of training-free zero-shot anomaly detection techniques can be applied successfully to the medical domain with minimal modifications. Code is available at https://github.com/jacomof/RADIOlogy.

summary.takeaway: 发现视觉语言模型多头注意力池化本身具备零样本异常定位与检测能力，据此提出单次前向、无需训练的RADIOlogy方法。
summary.methods: 采用简单对比打分，比较视觉特征与一组正常/异常提示的平均相似度；利用RADIO模型的凝聚特征，通过密集异常精炼流水线增强像素级分割；无需密集滑窗执行，并扩展至医学领域。
summary.relevance: 与多模态学习及跨模态理解相关，属于免训练零样本异常检测的视觉语言方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要称显著优于其他免训练基线，但未给出具体数值；医学领域适用性仅称需最小修改，未提供该领域结果细节。

papers.title: Creator 1.0: Phylogeny-Guided Stagewise Pretraining for Plant Genome Foundation Models across 1,000 Species
